svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 03 · Davis · 08/12 The Dairy (Common)
svg.desc: Out at the edge of campus the cows are up before class. You smell the barns before you see them. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
